sammendrag: We use Norwegian micro-data to identify the driving forces behind unemployment spells following temporary-and permanent dismissals.The duration of unemployment spells for permanently dismissed workers is primarily explained by individual resources and economic incentives, while spell-duration for temporary dismissed workers is explained by firm incentives.Higher benefits reduce the employment hazard for permanently-but i ncrease it for temporary dismissed workers.Structural duration dependence is nonparametrically identified and sharply estimated with the aid of lagged hazard rate variation and repeated spells.The employment hazards for both spell-types exhibit positive duration dependence during the first months and negative duration dependence thereafter.
tittel: Temporary layoffs and the duration of unemployment
